purpose: Continue increasing photo and individual source-page coverage for taxa below the nine-reference minimum, prioritizing taxa with the lowest current counts.
source_scope: Search exact species-level iNaturalist observations, GBIF still-image occurrence records, and Wikimedia Commons file pages matched by species-name text; prioritize the taxa with the lowest current reference counts and preserve source type, underlying photo links, taxon-match warning, attribution, and licence claims.
copy_policy: Archive only photo-level CC0 or CC BY iNaturalist candidate files; keep GBIF and Commons media pages, all other rights, and unknown rights as source links for owner review.
